markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (89%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set with 10% invasive risk [F1], unflagged tier 4 priority, and drafted ER stain order.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 89%, Invasive 10%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Strong margin over invasive carcinoma |
| Conformal set | InSitu at 10% error rate (90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] (error AUROC 70%) | Reliable input despite atypical OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models match top class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%) [F5]; closest Benign (81%) and Invasive (80%) | Mixed neighbors despite InSitu majority |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Scarce normal lobules; failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 7, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · High duct confinement; mixed AI spot check (12/20) [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Low stromal infiltration; passed AI spot check (19/20) [F4] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce benign stroma; passed AI spot check (20/20) · Validated
- **Tumor cellularity and nuclear size** (regions 1, 6, 10) · context · 94% tumor fraction [F7], 6922/mm² density [F8], 0th-percentile nuclear size [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive risk more than random (95% CI excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion CI includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stromal invasion exists in high-risk regions 6 (74%), 1 (74%), or 10 (47%), matching Invasive neighbor BACH_0138 (80%).
- Ductal proliferation is a benign mimic matching closest neighbor BACH_0330 (Benign, 81% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 1, 10**: Inspect highest-risk heatmap areas (74%, 74%, 47%) and dense tumor nuclei for stromal microinvasion.
2. **Regions 7, 9, 11**: Verify atypical cells remain duct-confined with intact myoepithelium before approving the drafted ER stain.
3. **Regions 8, 9**: Assess lobular architecture and stroma directly to exclude benign mimicry; disregard the region 9 lobule score.
